“I will pour upon the house of David the Spirit of grace and of supplication.”—Zech 12:10.
“I will pour out the Spirit of Supplication.”—Zech 12:10.

…There is a thirst this world can never quench: the more we drink of its pleasures, the thirstier we become. We cry out for more and more; and we are all the while being dragged down lower and lower. But there is “a fountain opened to the House of David . . . for sin and for uncleanness.” Let us press up to it, and drink and live.
“In that day there shall be a fountain opened to the house of David, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, for sin and for uncleanness.”
